# ZZSKY

> ZZSKY supplies SEG series fiber laser tube and sheet cutting machines for industrial manufacturers worldwide. Factory: Mengzhuang Industrial Park, Huixian, Xinxiang, Henan, China.

## Contact
- Email: sales@aorelaser.cn
- Phone: +86-400-832-8321
- Address: Mengzhuang Industrial Park, Huixian, Xinxiang, Henan, China

## Products
- [SEG-T120 / T120Q](/products/seg-t120): Standard round & square tube laser, 10–120mm
- [SEG-T160](/products/seg-t160): Standard tube laser, 10–160mm (bestseller)
- [SEG-T240](/products/seg-t240): Heavy tube laser, 15–230mm
- [SEG-T130Y](/products/seg-t130y): Offside tube laser with smart assist features
- [SEG-T100M](/products/seg-t100m): Dual-pneumatic no-CAD tube laser
- [SEG-100MZ](/products/seg-t100mz): Compact tube laser
- [SEG-2513](/products/seg-2513): Sheet fiber laser, 2500×1300mm
- [SEG-3015](/products/seg-3015): Sheet fiber laser, 3000×1500mm
- [AORE V12](/products/aore-v12): High-speed tube laser, Ø8–120mm, 2G feed, no-CAD

## Key facts
- Categories: tube fiber laser, sheet fiber laser, no-CAD tube cutting, offside tube laser, high-speed tube laser
- Typical power class: 1.5kW class (upgradable options)
- Applications: furniture, fitness equipment, automotive parts, sanitary ware, sheet metal shops
- Quote response: typically within 24 hours
